name: ISHMAELITE_CARAVAN
canonical: the Ishmaelite trading caravan bound for Egypt, a line of swarthy desert merchants with sun-darkened faces and dark beards, wrapped in striped flowing robes and head-cloths bound with cord, leading laden camels strung with bales of spicery, balm and myrrh across the shimmering desert sand
